evidence.detail: The base-to-target diff narrows auth.py's delegated scope and adds the approved focused tests and documentation updates; remaining changed files are issue handoff, review, and workflow records.
SCOPES is exactly https://graph.microsoft.com/Policy.Read.All; the existing request builder form-encodes the supplied value without changing the device-code flow.
Two focused tests assert the exact constant and decoded request-body scope. The complete auth test module passed independently: 22 tests, exit 0.
README now reports 85 tests in both current user-facing locations, and its least-privilege guidance names Policy.Read.All only.

The required full-suite command discovered 85 tests but exited 1 because all 22 server integration tests were denied permission to bind loopback sockets; the other 63 tests completed without reported failures.
The required compile command exited 1 because the read-only checkout prevented creation of __pycache__.
The governance validator exited 1 because the sandbox provided no writable temporary directory for launcher smoke tests.
The exact base-to-target diff passes whitespace validation.

The committed handoff records successful out-of-band checks at the candidate: 85 tests passed, compile exited 0, and repository validation passed. Under the binding review rules this author-provided evidence cannot replace independent execution.
The issue and current-status records now identify both prior review candidates and reports, mark this as repair round 2 of 2, and name a fresh review of the current candidate as the next action.

limitations: Independent execution evidence is incomplete: the full suite could not bind loopback sockets, py_compile could not create bytecode cache files, and validate_repo.py could not create a temporary directory under the read-only sandbox.

No live Microsoft tenant sign-in or Graph request was performed. The approved issue does not require that protected action, so delegated-consent behavior remains covered by request construction and mocked tests.
The author-recorded successful out-of-band checks are supporting evidence only and cannot independently establish the required check results.

The checkout is grafted at the target commit, so intermediate candidate objects from rounds 0 and 1 could not be independently reconstructed; their committed review reports and the complete supplied base-to-target diff were inspected.
review.summary: No actionable correctness, regression, scope, security, documentation, or maintainability defect was found. The scope narrowing, focused tests, README test counts, and workflow-record synchronization are consistent with ISSUE-0007. The review remains BLOCKED because all three required repository-wide checks could not complete independently in the read-only sandbox; the launcher explicitly prohibits PASS when required execution evidence is missing or failed.
